name: Gossamer Absolution
source:
There are no benefits to being at the bottom of the food chain.

A short, introspective visual novel about a bug trying to survive. Contains themes of depression, low self esteem/self worth, and general self-negativity. 

[From [url=https://bugbytegaming.itch.io/gossamer-absolution]Itch.io[/url]]
